sloka: ततस्ताभिः समेताभिर्नारीभिः स महाबलः ।प्रसाद्य सहसा नीतो भवनं स्वं निशाचरः ।। ५.५८.७८ ।।।।
transliteration: tatastābhiḥ sametābhirnārībhiḥ sa mahābalaḥ ।prasādya sahasā nīto bhavanaṁ svaṁ niśācaraḥ ।। 5.58.78 ।।।।

translations.english: "Then all the women got together and stopped the mighty nightranger, Ravana and quickly took him back to his mansion.
